STATEMENT OF WORK
Forloop — Customer Onboarding Portal for Halvane Financial

1. Project Overview

Forloop will design, build and launch a Customer Onboarding Portal for Halvane Financial, so that new
retail customers can open an account online, verify their identity, link a payment method and be
screened for fraud in a single guided flow. Forloop is an AI engineering company: the portal includes a
machine-learning fraud pre-screen that scores each application and routes risky ones to Halvane's
manual-review team. The engagement runs for an estimated 12 weeks from kickoff on 14 September 2026,
with launch at the end of Week 12 (4 December 2026). The agreed budget is 920 hours.

2. Team

Forloop:
- Nirmal Babu — Delivery Manager
- Ram Anandkumar — Technical Director
- Rucheek — Backend and Payments Engineer
- Elise Marchetti — Engineering Lead
- Kofi Mensah — Frontend Engineer
- Ana Beltrán — ML Engineer
- Jonas Weber — QA Engineer
- Hye-jin Park — Business Analyst

Phase 3: Payments (Weeks 5-9)
- Rucheek will integrate the payment gateway, first against its sandbox. This depends on the gateway

- Elise Marchetti will build the payment ledger and the daily reconciliation job.
- Kofi Mensah will build the payment method screens and the 3-D Secure flow.

Phase 4: Fraud pre-screen (Weeks 6-9)
- Ana Beltrán will prepare fraud-signal features from anonymised sample application data supplied by

- Hye-jin Park will define the manual-review rules with Halvane's risk team.

Forloop / Halvane Financial — Weekly Sync, Week 3
Date: Wednesday 30 September 2026
Attendees: Nirmal Babu, Ram Anandkumar, Elise Marchetti, Hye-jin Park, Kofi Mensah, Rucheek

Notes

Hye-jin confirmed the requirements specification is signed off by Halvane's compliance team, so it is
complete. Elise said the architecture and data model are also done and reviewed by Ram.

Kofi finished the onboarding screen mockups and Halvane approved them. He starts the front end next week.

Rucheek has started the onboarding API: account creation works end to end, document upload is next.
He asked Nirmal to chase Halvane about the ID-verification vendor, because production API access is
needed by Week 5 and the vendor said it can take three weeks.

Elise will build the document upload and secure storage in parallel with Rucheek's API work.

Nirmal will ask Halvane for the anonymised sample application data, needed by Week 5 for the fraud model.

Next sync: Wednesday 7 October.

Forloop / Halvane Financial — Weekly Sync, Week 6
Date: Wednesday 21 October 2026
Attendees: Nirmal Babu, Ram Anandkumar, Elise Marchetti, Hye-jin Park, Kofi Mensah, Rucheek, Ana Beltrán

Notes

Halvane's Head of Digital Onboarding asked for open banking account linking, so customers can connect
their bank account instead of entering card details. The team estimated about 52 hours. Nirmal raised
it as change request CR-01. The launch date has not moved, so Nirmal flagged that this puts the budget
and the schedule under pressure. Elise will own the open banking work.

Ana started preparing the fraud-signal features from the sample data.

The ID-verification vendor access and the payment gateway sandbox credentials are both still outstanding.
Rucheek and Ram are blocked on them. Nirmal will report both as issues to Halvane in writing.

Kofi said the front end is the team's bottleneck: he is carrying the front end, the notifications and the
payment screens in weeks 7 to 9.

The ID-verification vendor has still not granted production API access. Rucheek cannot start the KYC
integration without it, so that task is blocked. Nirmal will escalate with Halvane's Head of Digital Onboarding.

The payment gateway provider has not issued sandbox credentials. The payment gateway work cannot start
and is blocked too. Ram will raise it with the provider's account manager.

Halvane delivered the anonymised sample application data. Ana can now start preparing fraud-signal features.

Jonas started the test plan and the automated test suite.

Next sync: Wednesday 21 October.

The ID-verification vendor access and the payment gateway sandbox credentials are both still outstanding.

Kofi said the front end is the team's bottleneck: he is carrying the front end, the notifications and the
